title: Nvidia boss ends – level 1
paragraphs: Nvidia is a big tech company. Its boss, Jensen Huang, leaves his job suddenly. The company’s stock price falls.

Huang leaves after news about his relationship with a woman who may be a spy for China. Nvidia chooses another boss for some time. So the business stays safe. Experts say that it will be very hard to find a new leader. Huang is the boss for 33 years.
Now, US officials want to check if Nvidia breaks any rules. The company sells computer parts to China. This big problem may make trade between the US and China more difficult.
